title: Rosalind and the Horizon
author: Oscar Crane
blurb: Sable Crane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
